questions: What causes the O(n^2) in StreamSanitizer and can it be made O(n)?
How to prove the optimized path never emits raw PII?

findings.detail: push/flush sanitize the full buffer every token (stream_sanitizer.rs:43,55) -> O(n^2); B-35 proved sanitize linear.
module asserts settled prefix is byte-stable across pushes (:13-14) -> enabling invariant.
bounded-tail: emitted (sanitized offset) -> raw_released; sanitize only full_text[raw_released..cut]; O(n); no API/caller change.
equivalence rests on HOLDBACK>max-match (B-24b #121); binding gate = differential test incremental==whole-buffer over adversarial streams.
preserve UTF-8 char-boundary slicing, multi-word-split, clean-passthrough, flush-tail (3 existing tests = regression floor).
